charts.title: LP 791-18 d: orbits around LP 791-18
charts.description: The orbits of LP 791-18's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LP 791-18 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Peterson et al. 2023 (2023Natur.617..701P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PETERSON_ET_AL_2023): P 2.753436 d

charts.title: LP 791-18 d: its transit
charts.description: LP 791-18 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (63, 90, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 181804752, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 36 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 14 min late; 4-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 12 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
